name: Bond Famulus
effect: Cria um vínculo com um animal familiar, facilitando comandos e outros poderes de Animalismo.
cost: The animal must be fed the user’s Blood on three separate nights, each of which requires a Rouse Check by the user. The amount of Blood needed to sustain the ghoulstate of the animal after this is negligible. Players starting with this power have completed this process and can chose a famulus for free.
duration: Only death releases a famulus once bound. As long as it receives vampire Blood on a regular basis, the famulus does not age.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Without the use of Feral Whispers, below, giving commands to the animal requires a Charisma + Animal Ken roll (Difficulty 2); increase Difficulty for more complex orders. A vampire can only have one famulus, but can get a new one if the current one dies.

name: Sense The Beast
effect: Percebe a Besta, a hostilidade e a natureza sobrenatural de um alvo.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Roll Resolve + Animalism vs Composure + Subterfuge. A win allows the user to sense the level of hostility in a target (whether the person is prepared to do harm or even determined to cause it) and determine whether they harbor a supernatural Beast, marking them as a […]

name: Thrill Of The Hunt
effect: Reforça o rastreamento de presas, especialmente quando estão feridas.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When tracking prey add a bonus equal to your Hunger. After tasting someone's blood, living or undead, you can track them unerringly for the rest of the Scene.

name: Feral Frenzy
effect: Um chamado bestial provoca frenesi em criaturas que o ouvem.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a Manipulation + Animalism roll and lets out a feral sound, whether it be a howl, roar, or other animalistic call. The difficulty is determined by the natural aggression in the creature and availability of targets.

name: Feral Whispers
effect: Permite comunicar-se com animais e convocar os que estejam nas proximidades.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar per type of animal chosen for the scene. Allows one summoning and unlimited communication. Free when used on famulus.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Simple communication requires no dice pool test. Persuading an animal to perform a service requires a Manipulation + Animalism roll; the Difficulty depends on the task required.

name: Hunt The Beast
effect: Rastreia pelo cheiro a essência de uma Besta sobrenatural.
duration: One hour per margin of success vs a Difficulty determined by the Storyteller
opposing_pool: Autocontrole + Lábia or Determinação + Animalismo vs Difficulty determined by the Storyteller
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire rolls a contest of Resolve + Animalism vs Composure + Subterfuge to track a specific target. A win allows the user to smell and track the trail of a supernatural Beast. The user can also smell the hostility of the target along their path.

name: Leash The Beast
effect: Altera resultados específicos dos dados para conter manifestações da Besta ou auxiliar contra frenesi.
duration: Applied to the altered die result.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When you roll a 10 (potential Critical) on a normal die, you can turn that to a 9 (Success) by Rousing the Blood to activate this power.

name: Vermin Blood
effect: Transmite aos animais doenças despertadas na vitae do usuário.
duration: One Week
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): After activating this power you pour your blood out for your unwitting animal servants. Vermin, insects and other lower beasts are drawn to the pool of blood and those that feed from it become virulent disease carriers.

name: Warn The Pack
effect: Marca outro vampiro como ameaça aos olhos de quem está ao redor.
duration: One scene or until broken
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user calls out another vampire they can see as a threat and rolls a contest of Manipulation + Animalism vs the target’s Composure + Resolve.

name: Animal Succulence
effect: Melhora a alimentação com animais e permite benefícios ao consumir o familiar.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Feeding from animals slakes 1 additional Hunger, and the vampire counts their Blood Potency as two levels lower in regards to penalties to slaking Hunger from animal blood. Consuming one's famulus slakes 4 Hunger, regardless of animal size.

name: Bestial Spirits
effect: Projeta desejos violentos da Besta sobre mortais próximos.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): For every success rolled one Weak Mortal (see V5 Corebook pg. 185) within your immediate vicinity succumbs to a psychotic break as they are unable to hold back the violent urges of your Beast.

name: Mark Prey
effect: Marca um vampiro como presa, favorecendo ataques de outras criaturas com Besta.
duration: One Scene or until broken
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user verbally declares their target, who they must be able to see, and rolls a contest of Charisma + Animalism vs the Composure + Resolve of a target.

name: Quell The Beast
effect: Aquieta a Besta do alvo, reprimindo impulsos e agressividade.
duration: One scene, or a number of turns equal to the test margin plus one.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Roll Charisma + Animalism vs Stamina + Resolve. A win against a mortal target incapacitates them for that scene, instilling severe lethargy. They act only to preserve themselves, not against the user or anyone else.

name: Unliving Hive
effect: Permite empregar enxames de insetos como familiares e extensões de Animalismo.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): This power extends all powers previously restricted to vertebrates to insect swarms, treating a swarm as a single creature. The vampire can bind the swarm as a famulus, and some even give it the ability to nest inside the cavities of their body.

name: Pack Frenzy
effect: Distribui entre vampiros o fardo de um frenesi presenciado para torná-lo guiado.
duration: Frenzy duration (VtM Corebook p. 220)
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When the vampire must make a fury or terror Frenzy check, or witnesses another vampire succumb to a fury or terror Frenzy, they may make a Wits + Animalism to spread the Frenzy among any willing kindred they can see.

name: Subsume The Spirit
effect: Transfere a consciência para um animal e permite controlar seu corpo.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar. Free if used on famulus.
duration: A scene / indefinitely (see above)
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Make a Manipulation + Animalism test; Difficulty 4. On a win, the vampire can inhabit the animal’s body for one scene. On a critical win, the vampire can inhabit the animal indefinitely.

name: Animal Dominion
effect: Comanda grupos de animais como extensões da própria vontade.
duration: A single scene or until the directive is fulfilled, whichever is shortest.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Chose a type of animal and make a Charisma + Animalism roll with a Difficulty depending on the nature of the animals and the order given.

name: Drawing Out The Beast
effect: Transfere um frenesi de fúria ou terror para outro indivíduo.
duration: Frenzy duration (see p. 220)
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Instead of the Willpower roll to resist a terror or fury frenzy, roll Wits + Animalism vs Composure + Resolve of the target. If the user fails, they enter frenzy as though they had failed the Willpower roll.

name: Spirit Walk
effect: Amplia Subsume the Spirit, permitindo transferir-se entre corpos de animais.
cost: None, though the cost for Subsume the Spirit remains
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When using Subsume the Spirit, the duration is always indefinite as though a Critical result was obtained. Furthermore the Kindred can activate Subsume the Spirit even while inhabiting an animal’s form, transferring their consciousness to beast after beast.

name: Subsume The Servant
effect: Transfere a consciência para um carniçal que contenha o sangue do usuário.
duration: A scene or until ended early through destruction of ghoul or harm to vampire body, indefinitely on a critical success
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a Manipulation + Animalism test at Difficulty 4. On a win, the vampire’s mind inhabits a ghoul’s body (that currently has the user’s Blood in them) for one scene.

name: Heightened Senses
effect: Amplia os sentidos; estímulos excessivos podem causar sobrecarga.
duration: Until deactivated. Having the power active for longer stretches of time without rest (more than a scene), especially so for high-stimulus environments, might necessitate spending Willpower, at the Storyteller’s discretion.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user adds their Auspex rating to all perception rolls. If exposed to extreme sensations, such as loud bangs, flashes of intense light or overpowering smells while the power is active the user must succeed on a Wits + Resolve (Difficulty 3 or more) roll to dampen […]

name: Lie Detector
effect: Permite perceber quando alguém está mentindo ao usuário.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When activated, add the Auspex rating of the user to any Insight checks to determine if they are being lied to. If successful, the user is able to see shifts in the target's aura whenever they speak a lie.

name: Sense The Unseen
effect: Detecta presenças e manifestações sobrenaturais ocultas.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever there’s something supernatural hiding in plain sight, the Storyteller makes a hidden roll of Wits + Auspex against a Difficulty they choose.

name: Decipher
effect: Lê intenção e significado para interpretar linguagens e códigos.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes an Intelligence + Auspex test against a Difficulty determined by the Storyteller based on the familiarity and complexity of the language or code. While the user can understand these messages, they are not able to speak the language or write in the code.

name: Dreams Of The Past
effect: Reconstitui por ilusão um estado anterior de um objeto ou ambiente.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Make an Intelligence + Auspex roll versus a Difficulty dependent on how much of the original object or environment remains. A slashed painting would be Difficulty 2, while a book burnt to ashes would be at least Difficulty 6.

name: Elysian Eye
effect: Investiga sonhos, lembranças recentes e sinais de manipulação dessas experiências.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar (plus one Willpower vs non-consenting vampires)
prerequisite: Unseen Sense You see into the dreams and recent memories of others and can detect if they’ve been manipulated.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can see the dreams of a sleeping vampire or mortal without having to make a roll, though line of sight is required. To glimpse the recent dreams or memories of an awake mortal within line of sight, roll Wits + Auspex vs their Composure + Subterfuge.

name: Implant Dream
effect: Insere um sonho elaborado no próximo período de sono do alvo.
duration: Until the next time the target sleeps
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire either mentions a certain subject or concept or shows an image to their target and makes a Resolve + Dominate roll vs the target’s Composure + Intelligence.

name: Obeah
effect: Alivia sofrimento mental e restaura dano de Força de Vontade de outra pessoa.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar and additional Willpower depending on circumstances
duration: Não se aplica
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire rolls Composure + Auspex against Difficulty 2 and restores a number of superficial Willpower damage levels equal to the margin on the roll. Alternatively, the user restores one aggravated Willpower damage level for every three successes in the margin.

name: Premonition
effect: Produz pressentimentos ou visões que oferecem pistas ao personagem.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever the Storyteller deems it appropriate, this power gives the character a sudden hint that aids them in some way: letting them find a clue they’ve missed or saving them from danger.

name: Read Opponent
effect: Lê intenções e sinais físicos para antecipar ataques de um adversário.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar, plus 1 Teste de Despertar for every additional target
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a Wits + Auspex contest against their opponent’s Strength + Subterfuge. On a win, the user may add their Auspex rating to any defense rolls against physical attacks from the target.

name: Sense Strengths And Weaknesses
effect: Investiga pela aura os pontos fortes e fracos do alvo.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Make an Intelligence + Auspex vs Composure + Subterfuge roll. On a win, the vampire can choose to learn either the strongest attribute or weakest attribute of the target.

name: Eyes Of Chaos
effect: Detecta padrões ocultos e pistas enganosas.
duration: Passive EXAMPLE: Abraham Tillinghast's secret haven has been ransacked and his favorite ghoul murdered. Shotgun shells and crucifixes litter the floor, pointing to hunters as the obvious culprits.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When confronted with a scene or environment that has been 'staged', 'cleaned up' or 'doctored' through the use of supernatural powers or more mundane methods of concealment, you can roll Wits + Auspex to ascertain the motives and methods behind the cover up.

name: Lethe'S Kindness
effect: Rouba lembranças de uma vítima e as incorpora às próprias memórias.
duration: Indefinitely EXAMPLE: Abraham has cornered a young Anarch and recognizes their cut as belonging to a local biker gang run by an old rival.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Roll a contest of Manipulation + Auspex vs Intelligence + Resolve. Each point of margin allows the user to remove an additional memory. The victim is left with lost time and empty gaps in their memory.

name: Psychic Backlash
effect: Provoca uma reação mental dolorosa em quem tenta controlar ou investigar o usuário.
duration: Um turno
pool: Dependent on Supernatural ability defended against
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever the vampire successfully defends against any supernatural attempts to manipulate their mind such as through Dominate or Presence, they may make a Rouse Check to activate this ability.

name: Scry The Soul
effect: Lê a aura para investigar emoções, Ressonância e traços sobrenaturais.
duration: One turn, or Storyteller’s discretion
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Make an Intelligence + Auspex vs Composure + Subterfuge roll. On a win, the Storyteller truthfully answers a number of questions equal to the margin of the roll about the target’s aura and psyche, including: ◻ ◻ The emotional state of the subject ◻ ◻ The Resonance in […]

name: Share The Senses
effect: Acessa os sentidos de outro indivíduo.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Roll Resolve + Auspex at Difficulty 3. This Difficulty can go up depending on distraction, distance, and other factors, such as the amount of the user’s Blood that remains in the target.

name: Spirit’S Touch
effect: Investiga resíduos emocionais associados a objetos ou locais.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Make an Intelligence + Auspex roll versus a Difficulty depending on the information sought.

name: Clairvoyance
effect: Percebe acontecimentos nos arredores sem depender apenas dos sentidos físicos.
duration: A few minutes for information gathering, up to a night for vigilance.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Roll Intelligence + Auspex against a Difficulty based on the security and level of activity of the area. Using Clairvoyance on one’s own mansion would be Difficulty 3 while an unfamiliar city block in the slums of a major city would amount to 7 or more.

name: Possession
effect: Assume o corpo de um mortal, suprimindo temporariamente sua vontade.
duration: Until ended, voluntarily or involuntarily.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): This power can only be used on mortals. If the mortal is a ghoul, they must first be Blood Bound to the user. Before possession can begin, the vampire must have eye contact with their victim (See Dominate, p. 254).

name: Telepathy
effect: Lê pensamentos e transmite mensagens mentais.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar (plus one Willpower vs non-consenting vampires)
duration: Roughly one minute per Rouse Check. Increased to a full scene on consenting subjects.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user is not required to roll any dice to project their thoughts to another, vampire or mortal, though they do require line of sight. To read the mind of a mortal within line of sight, roll Resolve + Auspex vs Wits + Subterfuge while looking into their eyes.

name: Unburdening The Bestial Soul
effect: Remove Máculas ou protege contra novas Máculas, com consequências para o usuário.
cost: 2 Testes de Despertar, gain one Stain
duration: Uma sessão
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire spends a scene in seclusion with the subject and rolls Composure + Auspex vs. the Humanity of the subject.

name: Cat’S Grace
effect: Concede equilíbrio sobrenatural em superfícies estreitas e situações precárias.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user automatically passes any Dexterityor Athletics-based roll needed to keep their balance. Note that this power does not allow them to balance on support that cannot take their weight.

name: Fluent Swiftness
effect: Permite repetir determinados Testes de Despertar ligados a Surtos de Sangue de Destreza ou Rapidez.
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever the vampire uses a Blood Surge to augment a Dexterity or Celerity test, they may reroll the Rouse Check.

name: Rapid Reflexes
effect: Acelera reações e reduz dificuldades de certas ações defensivas ou menores.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): With this power, vampires suffer no penalty to their defense pools for lack of cover against Firearms attacks. They can also take a minor action (see p. 298) worth up to two dice per turn, such as readying or reloading a weapon, for free.

name: Control Momentum
effect: Redireciona o impulso de um ataque evitado contra outro alvo.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): During combat, after a successful Dexterity + Athletics contest to defend against a close range attack, the vampire may redirect the attack to a nearby opponent.

name: Fleetness
effect: Amplia a capacidade de executar ações que dependem de Destreza.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Add the Celerity rating to user's dice pool for non-combat Dexterity tests. Once per turn the user may also do this when defending with Dexterity + Athletics.

name: sCAN THE ROOM
effect: Acelera a investigação de detalhes e pistas em um ambiente.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can carry out a thorough investigation of a room in moments, perceiving auras and physically investigating clues with supernatural speed so they can quickly act on their findings or gather information before others are able to.

name: Blink
effect: Permite atravessar rapidamente uma distância curta.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire moves in a straight line toward a target, covering any distance under 50 meters while still having enough time to perform an action, such as an attack, during the turn.

name: Combat Tempest
effect: Facilita enfrentar vários adversários através de deslocamento contínuo.
duration: One action
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire does not receive a penalty for defending against multiple opponents (VtM Corebook p. 125), gaining their full dice pool for each contest. This includes pools that add the Celerity rating if other Disciplines are in effect such as Fleetness (VtM Corebook p.

name: Speed Is Power
effect: Converte a velocidade acumulada em força para uma ação.
duration: One action
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Provided the user has the space to build up appropriate speed for the action, the vampire may add half of their Celerity rating rounded up to a single action requiring Strength that does not require the user to be stationary.

name: Traversal
effect: Permite deslocar-se por superfícies verticais ou líquidas com velocidade sobrenatural.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Make a Dexterity + Athletics roll with a Difficulty of 3 (inclined surface with traction) to 6 (slick vertical surface, open water), depending on the surface and angle.

name: Draught Of Elegance
effect: Compartilha parte dos benefícios de Rapidez através do sangue.
duration: One night; for vampires, until the next feeding or the vampire reaches Hunger 5
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Drinking a Rouse Checks worth of Blood directly from the user gifts the drinker with temporary Celerity equal to half the Celerity dots (rounded down) of the donor. The drinker gains the same non-Amalgam powers as the donor’s, up to that level.

name: Faster Than Light
effect: Permite atravessar rapidamente fogo ou luz solar durante Blink, sob condições específicas.
duration: Uma ação
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When using Blink, the vampire makes an additional Rouse check, enabling them to pass through patches of sunlight or flame without sustaining damage or feeling their effects.

name: Furious Frenzy
effect: Concede velocidade e ações adicionais durante frenesi, com custo físico.
duration: One Scene or duration of Frenzy
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Upon entering a Frenzy, the vampire may choose to enter a Furious Frenzy and is able to make two actions per turn for the duration of the Frenzy. Any Criticals rolled during this state are considered Messy Criticals.

name: Long Distance Journey
effect: Permite manter velocidade elevada em viagens a pé.
duration: Half an hour, plus additional half an hour for every success above margin
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire makes a Stamina + Celerity check vs Difficulty 3. On a success, the user can run up to 30 kph (roughly 20 mph) per dot in Celerity. They can maintain this for half an hour, plus an additional half an hour for every success above the margin.

name: Unerring Aim
effect: Acelera a precisão de um ataque à distância, limitando a defesa do alvo.
duration: Um ataque
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Use before making a ranged attack. The target makes no roll to dodge or defend; make the attack at Difficulty 1. An opponent possessing Celerity 5 can nullify this power by making their own Rouse Check, defending at the same speed.

name: Lightning Strike
effect: Executa um ataque corpo a corpo em velocidade quase impossível de acompanhar.
duration: Um ataque
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Use before making a Brawl or Melee attack. The opponent makes no roll to dodge or defend; make the attack at Difficulty 1. An opponent possessing Celerity 5 can nullify this power by making their own Rouse Check, defending at the same speed.

name: Split Second
effect: Permite reagir a um acontecimento no último instante.
duration: Roughly one action, as determined by the Storyteller.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The player can supersede the Storyteller’s narration of events, within reason. They can choose to have their character move through a door before it closes, circumvent an ambush after it has been triggered, roll out of the way of an explosion, and so forth.

name: Cloud Memory
effect: Apaga lembranças dos momentos imediatamente anteriores.
duration: Indefinido
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No roll is required against an unprepared mortal victim. Clouding the memory of a resisting victim or another vampire requires a Charisma + Dominate vs Wits + Resolve roll.

name: Compel
effect: Impõe uma ordem simples de execução imediata.
duration: No more than a single scene
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No roll is required against an unprepared mortal victim. Commanding a resisting victim, a victim the vampire has previously Dominated in the same scene, or another vampire requires a contest of Charisma + Dominate vs Intelligence + Resolve.

name: Blood Leash
effect: Permite usar a própria vitae como veículo para Dominação.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When someone tastes your blood, you may immediately use one of your Dominate powers on them without having to make eye contact or issue a verbal command. You must pay the cost and roll any dice pools as is normal with the power.

name: Declare Weakness
effect: Convence o alvo de uma fraqueza, limitando seu desempenho.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No roll is required against an unprepared mortal. Effecting a resisting target or vampire requires a contest of Manipulation + Dominate vs Composure + Intelligence.

name: Dementation
effect: Desestabiliza mentalmente o alvo durante uma conversa.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): After engaging in conversation with a victim, the user can activate this power. For the duration of the scene, the user may attack a single individual each turn in a Manipulation + Dominate vs Composure + Intelligence conflict, causing Superficial damage to Willpower.

name: Domitor’S Favor
effect: Dificulta a resistência de um servo ao Laço de Sangue com o usuário.
duration: Um mês
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Defiance rolls for willful thralls under the effects of Domitor’s Favor are made at a three-dice penalty and thralls may not spend Willpower on them. Additionally, total failure on a defiance roll means that the Blood Bond does not weaken that month. See pp.

name: Mesmerize
effect: Implanta instruções mais complexas em um alvo.
duration: Until the command is carried out or the scene ends, whichever comes first.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No roll is required against an unprepared mortal victim. Commanding a resisting victim or another vampire requires a contest of Manipulation + Dominate vs Intelligence + Resolve. Commands that go against the victim’s nature also require such a contest.

name: Slavish Devotion
effect: Dificulta a resistência de vítimas já submetidas à Dominação.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Any attempt to mentally coerce a character already under the influence of the vampire’s Dominate has its Difficulty increased by two, or suffers a four-dice penalty in contests. The Difficulty cannot rise above 7.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Object Command
effect: Vincula uma ordem a um objeto para afetar quem o tocar.
duration: One night. On a critical, the effect is permanent.
pool: Same as Compel or Mesmerize, depending on which is used.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The kindred touches an object and imprints a command upon the aura of the item. The next person to touch the item triggers the effect, resulting in a contest of Manipulation + Dominate vs Intelligence + Resolve.

name: Submerged Directive
effect: Adia uma ordem de Mesmerize até que uma condição seja atendida.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): As Mesmerize, though the Storyteller might want to make any rolls in secret. There’s no way of knowing if the submerged suggestion works until the conditions are met.

name: The Forgetful Mind
effect: Reescreve segmentos da memória da vítima.
duration: Indefinido
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user rolls a contest of Manipulation + Dominate vs Intelligence + Resolve. Each point of margin allows the user to add or remove an additional memory. The victim recalls the edits vaguely, foggy ideations that can fall apart under close questioning.

name: Ancestral Dominion
effect: Explora a ascendência do sangue para reforçar a Dominação.
duration: Whichever comes sooner: until the com pelled action is taken or the scene ends.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): On a successful roll of Manipulation + Dom inate, the victim acts to fulfill the dominating vampire’s request, providing it doesn’t entail harming themself.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Mental Conditioning
effect: Enfraquece resistências mentais por uso repetido de Dominação.
duration: Until the target successfully resists a Domination attempt by the user
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever the vampire uses a Dominate power on a victim, but before they roll for success, they may make an additional Rouse check to add a lingering weakening effect to their target. If the Dominate power is successful, the user gains a breach in their victim’s mind.

name: Rationalize
effect: Faz a vítima justificar como próprias as ações impostas por Dominação.
duration: Indefinido
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): If pressed on their belief, the victim can make a Wits+Awareness test (Difficulty 5). A win makes them question their own statement, and possibly their sanity.

name: Whispers Of Unreason
effect: Desestabiliza mentalmente um grupo através da fala.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): After engaging in conversation with a group of victims, the vampire can activate this power. For the duration of the Scene, the vampire may attack as many mortals or vampires that can hear their voice.

name: Energy Vampire
effect: Drena energia mental da vítima durante uma conversa.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): After a conversation, even a one-sided talk from the user, the vampire may drain the Willpower of their target with a Manipulation + Dominate vs Composure + Intelligence contest.

name: Lethe’S Call
effect: Apaga grandes períodos de memória ou lembranças de uma pessoa ou evento.
prerequisite: cloud memory or the forgetful mind
duration: Indefinido
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user tests Manipulation + Dominate vs a target’s Intelligence + Resolve, though unprepared mortals cannot resist this power. Each success in the margin allows the user to wipe up to an entire week’s worth of memories from the target.

name: Mass Manipulation
effect: Estende poderes de Dominação a um grupo.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar in addition to the cost of the power amplified
duration: Conforme o poder ampliado
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can amplify any of their other powers to affect a group of people, mortal or vampire, at once. All of the victims need to see the eyes of the user. The user makes any needed roll against the strongest opponent in the group.

name: Terminal Decree
effect: Permite ordens que contrariem a autopreservação da vítima.
cost: No additional Hunger cost, but the Humanidade cost is potentially severe
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Terminal commands now must be resisted (see individual powers regarding rolls involved), rather than failing automatically.

name: Eternal Vigilance
effect: Reforça a resistência ao sono diurno.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can add their Fortitude rating to any checks made to stay awake during the day (Corebook p. 219).

name: Fluent Endurance
effect: Permite repetir determinados Testes de Despertar ligados a Surtos de Sangue de Vigor ou Fortitude.
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever the vampire uses a Blood Surge to augment a Stamina or Fortitude test, they may reroll the Rouse Check.

name: Resilience
effect: Amplia a capacidade de suportar dano físico.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user adds their Fortitude rating to their Health track.

name: Unswayable Mind
effect: Reforça a resistência a influência, coerção e manipulação.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user adds their dots in Fortitude as extra dice in any roll made to resist coercion, intimidation, seduction, or any other attempt to sway the user’s mind against their will. This power also works against supernatural abilities such as Dominate and Presence.

name: Enduring Beasts
effect: Compartilha resistência sobrenatural com animais.
cost: Free (for famulus); 1 Teste de Despertar (for other animals)
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can choose to extend some of their Fortitude powers to animals affected by their Animalism. Any animal thus imbued gains additional Health levels equal to the Fortitude dots of the vampire. Using this power on their famulus is free and automatic.

name: Mental Vault
effect: Protege informações importantes e facilita recordá-las com precisão.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire may store a number of memories equal to their Fortitude rating. Memories stored this way can be perfectly recalled and receive a bonus equal to twice user’s Fortitude rating to be protected from mental disciplines or social coaxing.

name: Return To Sender
effect: Expulsa violentamente objetos cravados no corpo, conforme as condições do poder.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): After taking damage from a projectile that is still embedded in them, the user can supernaturally force the objects from their body as a minor action and potentially harm any nearby targets by making a Stamina + Fortitude contest against the target’s Dexterity + […]

name: Self-Assurance
effect: Cria uma reserva de proteção contra dano social à Força de Vontade.
duration: One scene, until depleted, or the end of a social conflict.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): If engaged in social combat, the character can activate this Power. Once activated, the character can absorb Superficial Willpower damage equal to their Fortitude rating without it affecting their actual Willpower reserves.

name: Sleep Like Stone
effect: Reforça a resistência física do corpo durante o torpor.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Until revived from Torpor
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When the vampire enters torpor, they double their Fortitude rating added to their Health track through Resilience and treat all forms of damage as Superficial, even from fire and sunlight.

name: Toughness
effect: Reduz dano superficial físico conforme as condições do poder.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Subtract the Fortitude of the defender from all Superficial damage sustained. This occurs before halving the damage, and cannot reduce the damage below one.

name: Valeren
effect: Restaura dano físico de outro indivíduo.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar and additional Health depending on circumstances
duration: Não se aplica
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire rolls Intelligence + Fortitude against Difficulty 2 and mends a number of superficial Health damage levels equal to the margin on the roll. Alternatively, the user mends one aggravated Health damage level for every three successes in the margin.

name: Defy Bane
effect: Permite suportar temporariamente parte dos efeitos de fogo e luz solar.
duration: One scene or until expired, whichever comes first
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user can convert a number of Aggravated damage equal to their Fortitude rating to Superficial damage when sustained. They may not heal that Superficial damage for the rest of the scene. This power converts a number of damage per scene, not per wound or per attack.

name: Fortify The Inner Facade
effect: Protege pensamentos e emoções contra investigação sobrenatural.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Increases the Difficulty of using Scry Soul (Auspex 3), Telepathy (Auspex 5), and similar powers on the user by half their Fortitude rating (round up). If the rules allow the user to resist these powers, they add their Fortitude rating to their dice pool instead.

name: Seal the Beast’s Maw
effect: Reprime temporariamente a necessidade de alimentar-se.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): At any time during a scene, the vampire may make two Rouse Checks, and if their Hunger doesn’t increase, they can ignore the effects of Hunger for the remainder of the scene.

name: Comrade'S Aegis
effect: Recebe parte dos ferimentos de um aliado ligado pelo sangue.
duration: One night; for vampires, until the next feeding or the drinker reaches Hunger 5.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Drinking a Rouse Check's worth of Blood directly from the vampire creates a sympathetic link with the drinker.

name: Draught Of Endurance
effect: Compartilha benefícios de Fortitude através do sangue.
duration: One night; for vampires, until the next feeding or the vampire reaches Hunger 5
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Drinking a Rouse Check's worth of Blood directly from the user gifts the drinker with temporary Fortitude equal to half the Fortitude dots (rounded down) of the donor. The drinker gains the same powers as the donor’s, up to that level.

name: Khan'S Gambit
effect: Redireciona parte de um ataque recebido contra outro alvo próximo.
duration: One reaction
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can activate this power once per Scene as a reaction to an incoming melee or ranged attack that they can perceive.

name: Shatter
effect: Faz a resistência sobrenatural do usuário prejudicar o agressor ou sua arma.
duration: One scene (or until hit)
opposing_pool: Vigor (+ For titude, if the attacker is attacking unarmed and possesses Fortitude)
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Anyone who makes a successful Brawl attack against the user suffers the damage which Toughness subtracts (see Vampire: The Masquerade p. 258) as Super ficial Health damage.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Flesh Of Marble
effect: Endurece o corpo para resistir a ataques extremamente destrutivos.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): With this power active, the vampire ignores the first source of physical damage each turn, including fire but not sunlight.

name: Prowess From Pain
effect: Converte ferimentos em aumento temporário de capacidades físicas.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Upon activating the power the vampire no longer suffers any dice penalties from Health damage sustained, such as physical Impairment.

name: Cloak Of Shadows
effect: Oculta o usuário enquanto permanece imóvel e atende às condições de cobertura.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Follow the general rules for Obfuscate. The effect lasts until the user moves or they are detected by other means.

name: Empty Hands
effect: Oculta objetos ou armas carregados pelo usuário.
duration: One Scene or until detected
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): An object no larger than a rifle, briefcase, or canopic jar can be hidden from sight as long as it never leaves your possession. Only if an observer has their attention drawn to the object can they make a detection roll.

name: Ensconce
effect: Oculta pequenos objetos carregados ou segurados pelo usuário.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The Kindred can hide a number of small, hand-held objects in their hands or on their person equal to their Obfuscate rating. Mortals ignore dangerous or out-of-place objects that the user is enshrouding or miss them in a search.

name: Mask Of Ages
effect: Altera a idade aparente do usuário.
duration: Until sunrise or ended by the user.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Upon activating this Power, the Kindred choses to project their appearance as older or younger than their apparent age, as long as they remain roughly the same size. (Generally, late teens tend to be the lower limit).

name: Silence Of Death
effect: Suprime os sons produzidos pelo próprio usuário.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user silences their footsteps, clothing, minor collisions, and other sounds of their person. This makes the vampire undetectable if an observer could only notice them by sound, such as when on a different floor of a house.

name: Cache
effect: Estende Ensconce a objetos tocados, sem exigir contato contínuo.
duration: One scene or until dawn
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Objects affected by Ensconce need merely be touched, not held or carried by the Kindred. Furthermore, the user need not maintain physical contact with the object. The effect lasts for a scene.

name: Chimerstry
effect: Cria uma alucinação breve que afeta um sentido.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire rolls their Manipulation + Obfuscate. Anyone unprepared and within eyesight of the vampire and eligible to experience the hallucination (by being in line of sight of its projected appearance, or by being the target of a tactile sensation) is distracted, […]

name: Doubletalk
effect: Insere na fala uma mensagem secreta destinada a um ouvinte específico.
duration: One utterance.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The Kindred adds a secret message (up to one sentence) to their words that only a single intended listener can hear. Anyone else present only picks up the message if they can beat the user’s Composure + Obfuscate with their Wits + Auspex.

name: Ghost’s Passing
effect: Compartilha ocultação sobrenatural com animais.
duration: Uma sessão
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Animals under the user’s influence that the user targets with this power leave no track or trace that can be seen by mundane means. Sense the Unseen (Auspex 1) can still discern signs of an effected creature’s passing however, as per the general Obfuscate rules.

name: River Of Dreams
effect: Permite entrar em sonhos de mortais ou compartilhar sonhos por um vínculo de sangue.
cost: None or 1 Teste de Despertar during the day
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can briefly enter a mortal's dream while feeding on them. This allows them the ability to communicate with the mortal covertly and to experience their current dream as a direct bystander.

name: Unseen Passage
effect: Permite mover-se sob ocultação sobrenatural.
duration: One scene or until detection.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): As long as the user emits no overpowering odors and no sound louder than a whisper, this power automatically works. Only if the observer has their attention drawn to the user can they make a detection roll.

name: Duplicate
effect: Cria uma duplicata ilusória que acompanha os movimentos do usuário.
duration: One scene or until detection
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No roll is required, although those able to Sense the Unseen (VtM Corebook p. 261) can discern the illusion with a proper test. Any sound the user makes seems to come from the illusion, allowing conversations and other nonphysical interactions.

name: Fata Morgana
effect: Cria ilusões sensoriais mais elaboradas.
duration: One scene, unless the vampire chooses to let it lapse before that.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a Manipulation + Obfuscate test against a Difficulty equal to one plus the number of senses the hallucination targets.

name: Ghost In The Machine
effect: Estende a Ofuscação a transmissões eletrônicas e dificulta a identificação em registros.
duration: Conforme o poder utilizado
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No additional roll is required when being viewed on a live feed. Treat observers as present with the vampire, with regard to the Discipline.

name: Labyrinth Trail
effect: Cria rastros falsos para confundir perseguidores.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever anyone attempts to shadow you, they must first succeed on a Resolve + Investigation roll contested by your Manipulation + Obfuscate.

name: Mask Of A Thousand Faces
effect: Projeta uma aparência discreta e plausível para o ambiente.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No test is required. Anyone viewing the vampire sees a forgettable face of the same gender and approximate build and height as the user. Clothes take on the same kind of blandness, depending on the environment.

name: Mental Maze
effect: Desorienta o alvo, fazendo-o perder-se em um espaço ou percurso.
duration: Uma noite
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire personally speaks the words “you cannot escape” to their victim and rolls Charisma + Obfuscate versus the target’s Wits + Resolve, with lower Generation vampires being able to negate the roll with a Willpower point as per Dom inate’s characteristics (see […]
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Shape Aura
effect: Altera a aparência da aura lida por terceiros.
duration: Auspícios 1 The user can obscure auras, masking their true essence and giving false readings to others who may perceive the psyche. The kindred manipulates details such as their emotional state, supernatural origin, whether they have committed diablerie, and other aspects.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Make a Manipulation + Obfuscate vs Composure + Awareness roll. On a win, the user may make a number of changes to the target’s aura reading equal to the margin of the roll. This allows the various aspects able to be perceived with Scry the Soul (Corebook p.

name: Conceal
effect: Oculta um objeto imóvel da atenção de observadores.
duration: One night, with an additional night per point of margin on the win.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire touches the object and rolls a test of Intelligence + Obfuscate against a Difficulty from 2 (Concealing a ring in a drawer filled with other memorabilia) to 6 (Concealing a house in the middle of an open square), depending on the target’s size and location.

name: From Under The Bed
effect: Extrai de um mortal adormecido uma criatura de pesadelo controlável.
duration: Permanent as long as the nightmare creature is fed vampire blood on a weekly basis. If it is not fed the creature fades from existence unless it can find a new source of blood.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The successes rolled determine how much control the vampire initially has over the creature. The monster and its creator share a sympathetic link and they can communicate simple ideas without need of words or line of sight when they are near each other.

name: hIDDEN BLADE
effect: Distorce a percepção de uma arma, dificultando acompanhá-la em combate.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user rolls a contest of Wits + Obfuscate vs their opponent's Wits + Awareness. On a win, the user adds half their Obfuscate rating rounded up to Melee attack rolls.

name: Vanish
effect: Permite ativar a ocultação mesmo sob observação direta.
duration: Conforme o poder ampliado
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When vanishing in front of a mortal, roll a contest of Wits + Obfuscate vs Wits + Awareness. On a win, the observer questions whether the vampire was ever there to begin with; their memory clouds on the topic.

name: Cloak The Gathering
effect: Estende a Ofuscação do usuário a seus acompanhantes.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar in addition to the cost of the power extended
duration: Conforme o poder estendido
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can extend their power of Obfuscation to a number of additional willing subjects equal to their Wits, plus one for each additional Rouse Check made.

name: Fading Memory
effect: Dificulta recordar detalhes sobre o usuário após o encontro.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): After a scene has concluded, the vampire makes a Resolve + Obfuscate roll against a Difficulty determined by the Storyteller.

name: Impostor’S Guise
effect: Imita a aparência de uma pessoa específica.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user must study the face to be copied for at least five minutes, from different angles. The user requires another ten minutes of observation to mimic the subject’s voice and mannerisms. The user can only copy human appearance, not animal form.

name: Summon Spirit
effect: Convoca um espírito do mundo dos mortos.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The caster daubs the fetter with their vitae and makes an Oblivion Ceremony roll. The wraith cannot pass through the Shroud if it’s impenetrable in the Ceremony lo cation (see p. Ingredientes (original): One of the targeted wraith’s fetters, a photo or other visual depiction of the wraith or their signed name, the caster’s vitae.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: The Gift of False Life
effect: Anima cadáveres para executar tarefas simples e repetitivas.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The player makes their Ceremony roll and upon a win they raise a number of corpses equal to their Oblivion rating, or the number of bodies they have pre pared (whichever is lower). Ingredientes (original): A human body (or multiple bodies), a small concoction of blood, phlegm, and bile.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Traveler’s Call
effect: Envia a outro Shalimita um chamado sobrenatural e a localização do invocador.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): Ceremony roll, Difficulty 3. The target can ignore the call, but concentration is hindered for the scene.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Ashes to Ashes
effect: Acelera a destruição de restos mortais e, conforme as condições, afeta corpos ainda ativos.
duration: Variable (see Difficulty effects)
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire makes a Rouse Check to expend vitae, and introduces the vitae to the corpse. Unless the corpse is animated, the body disintegrates over three turns with no test necessary.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Oblivion’S Sight
effect: Permite perceber a escuridão sobrenatural e manifestações ligadas ao Oblívio.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): On activation, the user’s eyes become supernaturally attuned to darkness, allowing them to ignore all low-light penalties, including those of super natural origin. They still need their eyes to see and are affected by blindfolds and the like as usual.

name: Shadow Cloak
effect: Usa sombras para ampliar discrição e intimidação.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire gains a two-dice bonus to Stealth rolls, as well as on Intimidation versus mortals.

name: The Binding Fetter
effect: Detecta vínculos materiais associados a espíritos dos mortos.
duration: Variable (see Difficulty effects)
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): On activation, the user’s senses become supernaturally attuned to the energies of fetters, and they may identify these auras by sight, smell, and their other senses.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Awaken the Homuncular Servant
effect: Anima partes de corpos ou pequenos animais mortos como servos e espiões.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The necromancer’s player makes an Oblivion Ceremony roll, and after doing so, gains a homuncular servant that will spy, follow, or intimidate at the necro mancer’s command. Ingredientes (original): The required body part or animal car cass, the weapon used to sever/kill it, a small concoction of urine, fecal matter, and semen.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Compel Spirit
effect: Submete um espírito à vontade do usuário.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire’s player makes an Oblivion Ceremony roll vs. the wraith’s Resolve + Composure. If they have no way of physically threatening the fetter, the player must also make a Manipulation + Intimidation roll (Difficulty equal to the wraith’s Resolve + Composure). Ingredientes (original): A wraith’s fetter, the caster’s vitae, an item (or threat) sufficient to damage the fetter.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Maw of Ahriman
effect: Transforma um orifício corporal em vazio abissal que destrói matéria e afeta a vítima.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Until sunrise or cancellation; cancellation inflicts 1 Superficial Health damage.
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire’s player makes a Ceremony roll. The character’s mouth or another orifice becomes a void of inky blackness, destroying inanimate objects placed within in a matter of seconds. Ingredientes (original): A room that no light enters and is quiet as the grave.

name: Abyssal Pulse
effect: Usa o vazio do Abismo para desativar temporariamente equipamentos eletrônicos.
duration: One scene, or one night on a critical win
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes an Wits + Oblivion against a Difficulty determined by the Storyteller based on how much equipment is being targeted. On a success, the vampire disables all electronic machinery within an area of 1 meter/yard per rank in Oblivion centered on the user.

name: Arms Of Ahriman
effect: Manifesta braços de sombra para atacar ou imobilizar.
duration: One scene or until ended or destroyed
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user takes one turn and pays the cost, summoning the shadow appendages. Using these, the vampire can perform bludgeoning and grappling attacks against distant targets every subsequent turn.

name: Fatal Precognition
effect: Obtém uma visão relacionada ao destino mortal de alguém.
duration: Until fulfilled, avoided, or the story ends.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire must be able to see or hear their target when they use this power.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Shadow Cast
effect: Projeta a própria sombra de forma sobrenatural.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Activating the power conjures a supernat ural shadow from the vampire’s body. As long as the power is active, the user casts this shadow, which cannot be removed except by direct sunlight.

name: Where the Shroud Thins
effect: Identifica locais onde a Mortalha entre vivos e mortos é mais tênue.
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Following a Rouse Check, the player rolls Wits + Oblivion (Difficulty 3) and on a win may deter mine the density of the Shroud in their nearby area, as large as an entire building or landmark.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Host Spirit
effect: Abre o próprio corpo à possessão por um espírito.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire’s player makes a successful Oblivion Ceremony roll. If the wraith agrees to the prop osition, it then enters the vampire’s body and can remain for a number of scenes equal to the successes rolled on the Oblivion Ceremony roll. Ingredientes (original): A gift to be made as tribute to a wraith (whether the wraith values it depends on the individual), a parasitic bug, two teeth extracted from the vampire’s mouth
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Name of the Father
effect: Invoca Shalim para paralisar a vítima com desespero e privação sensorial.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire’s player makes their Ceremony roll vs. the victim’s Resolve + Composure. On a win, the vampire may activate this Ceremony’s effects any time they are in the victim’s presence. Ingredientes (original): The ability to speak ancient Greek, eye contact with a victim, five charcoal sticks
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Shambling Hordes
effect: Ergue grupos de mortos ambulantes agressivos.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The player makes their Ceremony roll, possibly incurring Stains in the process depending on the Chronicle Tenets and the Storyteller’s discretion. Due to the amount of blood spilled in this Ceremony, the caster must test to resist hunger frenzy (Difficulty 2). Ingredientes (original): A human corpse (or multiple human corpses), a fresh human sacrifice.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: The Shallow Slumber
effect: Enfraquece temporariamente a vitalidade do sangue para reduzir o tempo em torpor.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
prerequisite: Passion Feast or TOUCH OF OBLIVION
duration: Indefinite, so long as the sigils remain.
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): So long as the sigils remain on the target’s body, for each success in the margin on the ceremony test, their Blood Potency counts as one lower for the purpose of torpor duration and premature awakening. Ingredientes (original): Charcoal and one Rouse Check of the user’s vitae.

name: Witness The End
effect: Permite testemunhar os últimos momentos de um cadáver através de seus órgãos sensoriais.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): After swallowing the eye and ear (one or the other can be used to only see or hear what the victim did), the vampire makes the Ceremony roll. On a win, the user goes into a trance and can only perceive the final moments as perceived by the cadaver before they died. Ingredientes (original): A mostly intact eye and ear of a corpse

name: Aura of Decay
effect: Projeta uma influência entrópica que deteriora formas de vida próximas.
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire makes a Rouse Check. Following a Stamina + Oblivion roll (Difficulty 3), unin telligent organic and inorganic material within 5 yards/ meters of them suffers — plants turn black and die, food rots in its packaging, and even bricks start crumbling.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Passion Feast
effect: Permite alimentar-se das paixões de espíritos.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): A vampire with this power can drain a wraith of their passion. While in close proximity (three yards/meters or closer) to the wraith, they may roll a contest of Resolve + Oblivion vs. the wraith’s Resolve + Composure.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Shadow Perspective
effect: Permite perceber o ambiente a partir de uma sombra distante.
duration: Up to one scene
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Following a Rouse Check, the presence of the vampire in the shadow is undetectable by anything but supernatural means. (Sense the Unseen, for exam ple).

name: Shadow Puppet
effect: Controla a sombra de outra pessoa para influenciar seus movimentos.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When another creature's shadow is visible to you, the user may take control of it with a successful Resolve + Oblivion vs the opponent's Resolve + Composure. On a win, the user may use their actions to control the shadow as long as they can see it.

name: Touch Of Oblivion
effect: Canaliza entropia destrutiva através do toque.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Following a Rouse Check, the vampire grips their victim (requiring a Strength + Brawl roll if the victim is trying to avoid the vampire), with the victim suffering two levels of Aggravated damage as well as a crippling injury.

name: Bind the Spirit
effect: Vincula um espírito a uma pessoa ou lugar.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): Following the steps of the Ceremony, the vampire may incur Stains from the murder depending on the Chronicle Tenets and the Storyteller’s discretion. Ingredientes (original): A wraith’s fetter, the caster’s vitae, the sacrifice of an innocent human, sufficient salt to surround a property or individual.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Split the Shroud
effect: Abre uma passagem na Mortalha entre o mundo dos vivos e o dos mortos.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The caster kills the human sacrifice, which may result in Stains depending on the Chronicle Tenets and the Storyteller’s discretion. Ingredientes (original): A scalpel that’s been used to cut into someone living, chalk or charcoal, a silk sheet, a human sacrifice.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Necrotic Plague
effect: Transmite uma condição de decomposição pelo toque.
duration: One turn to activate, variable length of condition
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a Rouse Check and then rolls Intelligence + Oblivion while touching their victim. If the victim is weak (a baby, elderly, unwell, recovering from an illness, dying, or with 3 unmarked Health boxes or less), they are automatical ly infected.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Stygian Shroud
effect: Cria uma área de escuridão sobrenatural opressiva.
duration: One scene chapter six: Lasombra
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a Rouse Check and spends a turn concentrating, spreading the shadow over the desired surfaces. The effect covers a circular area with a radius equal to twice the user’s Oblivion rating in yards/ meters.

name: Ex Nihilo
effect: Permite ao usuário e acompanhantes entrar fisicamente nas Terras das Sombras.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Until the power is deactivated or the vampire is destroyed
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes three Rouse Checks (suf ficient to expend the required vitae) and spends a turn concentrating, expending a Willpower point to prepare for the crossing. They then make their Ceremony roll. Ingredientes (original): Masks for each par ticipant, a bowl containing sufficient quantity of the caster’s vitae so each participant might coat the soles of their feet in it, two coins of any value per […]
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Lazarene Blessing
effect: Devolve atividade a um corpo recém-morto, com consequências descritas na Cerimônia.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): Killing a mortal for this Ceremony may incur Stains, depending on the Chronicle Tenets. If the replacement heart was likewise taken from someone the vampire murdered, that murder might also incur Stains. Ingredientes (original): One human sacrifice, incense, the heart of any mammal, powdered silver.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Pit of Contemplation
effect: Abre uma passagem que aprisiona vítimas em um vazio de Oblívio.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Categoria: Cerimônia. Sistema (original, trecho): Following the Ceremony steps, the priest’s player makes their Ceremony roll, and on a success the effect is quick and implosive. A hole opens at the point where ink and blood mix. Ingredientes (original): Pot of ink, three pints/six liters or more of blood from an innocent the user murdered, an unlit room (this power does not work outside)
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Shadow Step
effect: Permite deslocar-se entre sombras.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire must enter a shadow large enough to cover them, and emerge from another one turn later. The target shadow must be within sight, though it can be perceived by mystical means, such as Shadow Perspective, if desired.

name: Skuld Fulfilled
effect: Interfere no destino de uma vítima, impondo uma morte prevista pelo poder.
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Conferir condições e exceções na fonte.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Tenebrous Avatar
effect: Transforma o usuário em uma manifestação de escuridão.
duration: One scene or until ended
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The transformation takes one turn, during which the vampire is unable to do anything else. Once the transformation is complete the vampire can move at walking pace across the ground or along walls, hampered only by hermetically sealed barriers.

name: Withering Spirit
effect: Ataca o espírito do alvo com entropia e decadência sobrenaturais.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire makes two Rouse Checks to expend sufficient vitae to coat both hands, and touch es the victim. After rolling Resolve + Oblivion vs.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Fluent Strength
effect: Permite repetir determinados Testes de Despertar ligados a Surtos de Sangue de Força ou Potência.
duration: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir sistema
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Whenever the vampire uses a Blood Surge to augment a Strength or Potence test, they may reroll the Rouse Check.

name: Lethal Body
effect: Torna ataques desarmados especialmente destrutivos contra mortais.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user’s unarmed attacks can now do Aggravated Health damage to mortals, if desired. They also ignore one level of armor per Potence level of the user.

name: Soaring Leap
effect: Amplia sobrenaturalmente a distância e a altura dos saltos.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user can jump a number of meters equal to three times their Potence level vertically, and five times their Potence level horizontally. The user needs no run-up to make these leaps.

name: Prowess
effect: Amplia a força aplicada a ações físicas e combate.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When activated, add the Potence rating of the user to their unarmed damage value as well as to feats of Strength.

name: Brutal Feed
effect: Acelera a alimentação, causando ferimentos graves à vítima.
duration: Uma alimentação
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can drain a human completely in seconds, usually within a single turn. Every point of Hunger slaked causes one point of Aggravated Health damage to the victim, as their blood vessels burst and organs bruise and rupture internally.

name: Fastball Special
effect: Permite arremessar um aliado ao combate e transmitir parte da força do usuário.
duration: One round
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a Strength + Potence to throw a creature. If throwing an ally, the ally may make a close combat attack roll as normal and add half of the successes of the user rounded down as damage to their attack.

name: Spark Of Rage
effect: Incita raiva e violência em outras pessoas.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When active, the user can add their Potence rating to any attempt to rile or incite a person or a crowd to violence. In addition, the user can activate this power and roll a contest of Manipulation + Potence vs Composure + Intelligence of another vampire.

name: Uncanny Grip
effect: Permite agarrar e escalar superfícies com força sobrenatural.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): A vampire using this power automatically succeeds on any Skill test to climb a non-metallic surface. The user might also be able to climb copper or bronze cladding or other softer metal surfaces, at the Storyteller’s discretion.

name: Draught Of Might
effect: Compartilha benefícios de Potência através do sangue.
duration: One night; for vampires, until the next feeding or the vampire reaches Hunger 5
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Drinking a Rouse Checks worth of Blood directly from the user gifts the drinker with temporary Potence equal to half the Potence dots (rounded down) of the donor. The drinker gains the same powers as the donor’s, up to that level.

name: Juggernaut
effect: Permite avançar com força devastadora através de obstáculos e oponentes.
duration: Um uso
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Once per Scene you can smash through anything in your path, moving up to the same distance as your Soaring Leap. Everyone within one meter of your path must make a Dexterity + Athletics roll (Difficulty 2), with results below.

name: Earthshock
effect: Produz uma onda de choque ao atingir o chão.
duration: Um uso
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No additional test is needed to create the shockwave. (The ground is hard to miss.) Anyone within a fivemeter radius of the user must make a Dexterity + Athletics roll (Difficulty 3), with the results below.

name: Fist Of Caine
effect: Permite causar dano agravado com ataques desarmados.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): For one scene the user can inflict Aggravated Health damage to mortals and supernaturals alike while Brawling, as they literally rend flesh and tear their opponents limb from limb with their bare hands.

name: Awe
effect: Atrai a atenção e aumenta o poder de persuasão do usuário.
duration: One scene or until intentionally ended
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Add the Presence rating to any Skill roll involving Persuasion or Performance as well as to other Charismarelated rolls, at the Storyteller’s discretion.

name: Daunt
effect: Projeta uma presença ameaçadora que intimida e afasta.
duration: One scene or until intentionally ended
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Add the user’s Presence rating to any Intimidation rolls. Attacking the user requires a Resolve+Composure roll at Difficulty 2. Vampires cannot use Awe and Daunt simultaneously.

name: Bring It On
effect: Amplia a ameaça percebida para provocar os inimigos a atacar.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): All nearby enemies immediately become aware of you. For the rest of the Scene they must make a Resolve + Composure roll at Difficulty 3 to target anyone else with an attack or power.

name: Lingering Kiss
effect: Torna os efeitos do Beijo mais intensos e duradouros sobre mortais.
duration: Until successfully resisted
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire can choose to use this power or not during each feeding. The user adds dice equal to their Presence to any subsequent Charisma Attribute-assisted pool against the bitten subject.

name: Predator’S Lure
effect: Atrai subliminarmente uma vítima próxima para o predador.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): You summon a victim within 50 meters to your current location. If you cannot see your victim this power requires a Rouse check. Mortals normally succumb to this power without a roll but paranoid, wary, or particularly alert mortals may attempt to resist your call.

name: Subtle Messages
effect: Altera sutilmente o estado emocional do alvo.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user must have the attention of the target and win a contest of Manipulation + Presence vs Composure + Wits. On a win, the subject begins feeling an emotion designated by the user though they are unsure of why and do not realize it is due to the vampire.

name: Throne Room
effect: Usa a organização de um ambiente como veículo para Presença.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire chooses a space to arrange. This could be their haven, a dark alley they bring victims to, a board room, or any space that can be arranged in a particular way without major disturbance.

name: Dread Gaze
effect: Revela a natureza predatória para provocar terror.
duration: Um turno
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Displaying their fangs, their face twisted in a predatory grimace, the user rolls a contest of Charisma + Presence against their target’s Composure + Resolve. Failure: Mortals are unable ◻ ◻ to act other than in their own defense, backing off for a turn.

name: Entrancement
effect: Induz fascínio intenso por uma pessoa.
duration: One hour plus one per point of margin
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire only needs to gain the subject’s attention and win a contest of Charisma + Presence vs Composure + Wits. The effect lasts for roughly one hour plus one per point of margin on the win.

name: Invigorating Display
effect: Absorve Ressonância de uma plateia mortal durante uma apresentação.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire spends a scene entertaining a crowd of mortals (a minimum of ten people are required), Rousing the Blood and making a Composure + Presence test against Difficulty 3 (Storytellers may raise or lower this depending on the quality of the performance).

name: Obsession
effect: Provoca obsessão por uma pessoa ou objeto destacado pelo usuário.
duration: One hour plus one per point of margin
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire tells their victim reasons why they should covet, admire, or desire a certain person or object. This subject must be within sight of both the user and their target.

name: True Love’s Face
effect: Projeta uma aparência emocionalmente significativa para o alvo.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): To impersonate some one the victim has strong emotions for, the vampire must know their appearance and what the victim feels for them. How they uncover this will vary between vampires.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: Twist Words
effect: Usa as palavras de um alvo para enfraquecê-lo socialmente diante de uma audiência.
duration: Uma noite
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When engaged in Social Combat in front of an audience, the user may make an Insight + Presence roll against the target’s appropriate Social roll.

name: Hideous Laughter
effect: Provoca risos incapacitantes através de uma apresentação cômica.
duration: One minute plus an additional minute per point of margin
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user needs the attention of their victim and to do or say anything that is intended to be funny and roll Charisma + Presence vs the target’s Composure + Wits.

name: Irresistible Voice
effect: Permite canalizar Dominação pela voz sem o contato visual normalmente exigido.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user's voice alone is now enough to Dominate a target. This does not apply to voices transmitted through electronic media such as phones, television, or apartment door-buzzer speakers.

name: Summon
effect: Convoca alguém anteriormente afetado por determinados poderes de Presença.
duration: Uma noite
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user needs to concentrate for five minutes and think of the person being summoned, then rolls Manipulation + Presence vs Composure + Intelligence. On a win, the target hears the summoning, but may or may not heed it.

name: Wingman
effect: Concede a outro vampiro voluntário o benefício de um poder de Presença.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar in addition to power used
duration: Conforme o poder utilizado
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): As a full action and with an additional Rouse Check, the user can provide the benefits of one of their Presence powers to another willing vampire, using the Presence rating and Blood Potency bonus of the vampire using Wingman.

name: Majesty
effect: Projeta uma autoridade sobrenatural que dificulta agir contra o usuário.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): People in the presence of the user can only stare, slackjawed, or avert their eyes in fear or submission. Anyone wanting to act in any way in opposition to the user, except for selfpreservation, must successfully win a contest of their Composure + Resolve vs.

name: Mind Prison
effect: Aprisiona a consciência da vítima em uma realidade ilusória.
duration: Twenty Four Hours
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes a contested roll of Resolve + Presence vs the target’s Intelligence + Resolve. On a win, the user describes a scenario or setting that the victim becomes mentally trapped in.

name: Star Magnetism
effect: Estende efeitos de Presença a transmissões ao vivo.
duration: Conforme o poder utilizado
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Awe, Daunt, and Entrancement can be transmitted through live feeds via screens or phones. If Entrancement is used, the victim’s name must be spoken clearly, as that power only affects one person at a time.

name: Blindsight
effect: Permite perceber o entorno sem depender dos sentidos humanos usuais.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): This power allows a vampire to see, feel, hear and smell their immediate surroundings with great precision. They can even detect heat signatures, faint scents, subsonic sounds, and changes in air pressure.

name: Eyes Of The Beast
effect: Permite enxergar em escuridão total; os olhos assumem brilho sobrenatural.
duration: Enquanto desejado
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No roll is required to activate Eyes of the Beast. While active the user ignores any sight penalties imposed by darkness, including supernatural. While active, the inhuman appearance of the eyes confers two bonus dice to Intimidation pools against mortals.

name: Shed Skin
effect: Descarta a aparência de ferimentos ao regenerar o corpo, sem necessariamente eliminar todo o dano.
duration: Uma noite
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When a vampire Rouses the Blood to Mend their wounds, they may choose to use this Discipline to spend a turn shedding their skin. This reveals a new layer of skin underneath that appears as the vampire does in perfect health. The shed skin instantly disintegrates.

name: Trophy Hunter
effect: Permite reutilizar a aparência de vítimas como disfarce.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Once per Session, after killing someone by feeding on them you can take on their appearance or voice. Your flesh instantly shifts to mimic them once the last of their blood ebbs away. This transformation lasts until your next feeding or until your Hunger reaches 5.

name: Weight Of The Feather
effect: Reduz a massa efetiva do corpo e facilita suportar quedas e superfícies frágeis.
duration: Enquanto desejado
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): If the vampire has time to prepare, no roll is required. As a reaction, such as during a sudden fall, activating the power requires a Wits + Survival roll at Difficulty 3.

name: Feral Weapons
effect: Transforma unhas ou presas em armas naturais monstruosas.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No skill roll is needed to activate this power. When activated, the vampire adds a +2 modifier to their Brawl damage, and causes Aggravated Health damage to mortals. Superficial damage inflicted from Feral Weapons is not halved.

name: Flense
effect: Arranca e remodela brutalmente a carne de uma vítima.
duration: Uma cena
