notes: Sistema (original, trecho): For the rest of the Scene your unarmed attacks gain a +2 damage modifier and Superficial health damage inflicted by your unarmed attacks are not halved while Flense is active.

name: Serpent’s Kiss
effect: Injeta a própria vitae durante uma mordida ou beijo.
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): When the Kindred bites or kisses another, they may make a Rouse check to force some of their own vitae into their victim.

name: The False Sip
effect: Mantém o sangue ingerido separado do organismo, adiando seus efeitos.
duration: One scene or more
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The character must activate this power immediately upon consuming blood from any source. The user is able to keep the blood down, but it doesn’t enter their system nor slake any Hunger, though the user can taste it.

name: Vicissitude
effect: Remodela o próprio corpo, redistribuindo características dentro dos limites do poder.
duration: Permanente
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Roll Resolve + Protean. Every success on the roll allows a single Vicissitude change to be made to the user, though the total number of changes cannot exceed the user’s Protean rating, no matter the number of applications or successes.

name: Earth Meld
effect: Permite fundir-se ao solo para proteção e repouso.
duration: One day or more, or until disturbed
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No test is required, but the vampire must be on a natural surface: rocks, raw earth, grass, etc. This power does not work on concrete, asphalt, or other artificial surfaces.

name: Fleshcrafting
effect: Estende a remodelação de carne e ossos a outras pessoas.
duration: Permanente
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): In order to use this power, the user must be able to work undisturbed on the subject, who thus either needs to be willing or restrained. For a willing subject, follow the same system as Vicissitude (above).

name: Masque Of Death
effect: Assume a aparência e a imobilidade de um cadáver.
duration: Until ended by the user or the user wakes from Torpor, otherwise until sunset.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The Kindred assumes the appearance of a corpse, either freshly dead, mummified, rotting, or even a dried-up skeleton.

name: Shapechange
effect: Transforma o usuário em uma forma animal compatível com os limites do poder.
duration: One scene unless ended voluntarily before that
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No test is required. The transformation takes one turn, during which the user may take no other actions. Upon transformation, the vampire gains the Physical Attributes, senses, and native Skills associated with that animal (see p.

name: Tools Of Nature
effect: Reproduz características fisiológicas de animais sem uma transformação integral.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar Dice Mechanics: Determinação + Animalismo
duration: Uma cena
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user makes an Animalism + Resolve roll against a Difficulty determined by the Storyteller based on the complexity of the alteration.

name: Whispers To The Flesh
effect: Usa a voz para desfazer a carne do inimigo à distância.
duration: One Attack
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire rolls a contest of Intelligence + Protean vs Stamina + Composure. (Vampires with Fortitude may resist with Stamina + Fortitude.).

name: Horrid Form
effect: Assume uma forma monstruosa preparada para confronto.
duration: One scene, unless voluntarily ended sooner.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Horrid Form takes a full turn to activate, during which time the vampire can only defend, using their pre-Horrid Form dice pools. It then grants the vampire a number of free Vicissitude changes (no Attribute dots are lost) equal to their Protean rating.

name: Metamorphosis
effect: Acrescenta uma forma animal e amplia as possibilidades de alteração de tamanho.
duration: One scene unless ended voluntarily before that
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Same as Shapechange.

name: Swarm Form
effect: Transforma o corpo em um enxame de criaturas pequenas.
duration: One scene unless ended voluntarily before that
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The vampire becomes a sentient swarm, able to use the senses of all creatures within it but unable to separate beyond a tightly clustered swarm. Otherwise, the vampire gains the Physical Attributes, senses, and native Skills associated with that animal (VtM Corebook p.

name: Traverse The Earth
effect: Permite deslocar-se através de terra natural durante Earth Meld.
duration: Same as Earth Meld
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): While inside the earth, the vampire can slowly travel through natural earth following the same restrictions as Earth Meld. The user can travel at a walking pace and perceives their surroundings through supernatural means.

name: Bloodform
effect: Transforma o corpo, integral ou parcialmente, em uma massa de sangue.
duration: One scene or until the user ends the transformation
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user transforms themselves into a liquid. In this form, they cannot be harmed by most conventional weapons (including stakes), though sunlight and fire still affect them as normal.

name: Face Of The Victim
effect: Copia a aparência da última pessoa de quem o usuário se alimentou.
duration: Until reaching Hunger 5, or using this power again.
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The Kindred must activate this power in the same scene after they’ve slaked one or more Hunger from a mortal or Kindred.

name: Master Of Forms
effect: Amplia o repertório de formas animais de Shapechange e Metamorphosis.
duration: As Shapechange or Metamorphosis
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user is no longer limited to choosing one animal form when using Shapechange or Metamorphosis. Rather, they can take on the form of any creature that falls within the limits of those abilities, different each time if they so wish.

name: Mist Form
effect: Transforma o corpo em névoa.
duration: One scene unless ended voluntarily before that
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No roll is required. The transformation takes three turns, though it can be sped up with additional Rouse Checks on a one-for-one basis. While in mist form, the vampire moves at walking pace and perceives their surroundings through mystical means as if there as normal.

name: One With The Land
effect: Estende a integração do corpo ao território e permite percebê-lo sobrenaturalmente.
duration: One day or more, or until physically disturbed
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): As with Earth Meld (see Vampire: the Masquerade, p. 270), except the vampire is not limited by the makeup of the surface where they take their rest.

name: The Heart of Darkness
effect: Permite separar o coração do corpo, com consequências específicas para dano e destruição.
cost: Não indicado em campo próprio; conferir regra da categoria
duration: Permanent (or until the heart is destroyed/returned)
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): This power requires no roll, but inflicts two Aggravated Health damage to the vampire when removing their heart. No powers can be used to mitigate this damage, and reattaching the heart requires two Rouse Checks.
source: Cults of the Blood Gods — Backer’s Copy

name: The Unfettered Heart
effect: Torna o coração móvel e dificulta a imobilização por estaca.
duration: Passivo
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): Increases the Difficulty on any non-combat test to stake the vampire by three. In Melee combat, only if the stake-wielder rolls a critical win does the stake penetrate the user’s heart.

name: A Taste For Blood
effect: Obtém informações sobre a origem de uma amostra de sangue.
duration: Não se aplica
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): The user dabs the blood on their tongue and makes a Resolve + Blood Sorcery roll (Difficulty 3). With a win, the user can determine the resonance and intensity of the blood if human.

name: Chains Of Morpheus
effect: Aprisiona um mortal nos próprios sonhos, dificultando despertá-lo.
duration: One Night
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): After placing a drop of your blood on a sleeping mortal, they enter a deep and dream filled sleep. They cannot be awakened from this sleep unless they are wounded, though they can be carefully fed upon by vampires without risking awakening them.

name: Corrosive Vitae
effect: Torna o próprio sangue corrosivo contra materiais inertes.
duration: Não se aplica
notes: Sistema (original, trecho): No additional skill roll is required. The user concentrates for a turn and forces Blood through an open, usually self-inflicted, wound.

name: Koldunic Sorcery
effect: Vincula os sentidos a um elemento e permite percepção sobrenatural através dele.
cost: 1 Teste de Despertar, and some Aggravated Health damage.
prerequisite: Tzimisce; first dot of Blood Sorcery; initiation described in the source.
duration: One scene; renewable during the same night with additional cost. Expires at sunrise.
